title: AI Promo Video Maker for New Products | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product photo into a launch video. Pick 9:16 or 1:1, at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Add the release date and offer in your editor after download.
h1: AI Promo Video Maker for the Day You Release
lead: Pick a reveal scene and add one photo of the finished item, so the launch clip is ready when the date is set.
steps_h2: Make a Facebook Promo Video in 3 Steps
steps_lead: One photo of the finished item, a short line about the reveal, then a file you can post.

steps.d: Use one clear photo of the finished item you plan to release. Keep the whole product inside the frame.
Name a reveal, an unboxing, or a short demo. Then pick 9:16 or 1:1 and a length from 6 to 30 seconds.
Download the file and add the release date and offer in your editor. Do not promise a date you have not set.

faq.q: What is an AI promo video template?
faq.a: A ready reveal, unboxing, or demo scene for a product you are about to release. You add a photo of the finished item, and the clip announces it.

faq.q: How do I make the launch clip?
faq.a: Upload the finished-item photo, name the reveal, pick 9:16 or 1:1 and a length, then download the file and add the date in your editor.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of a launch shoot?
faq.a: The reveal is built from a photo of the final item. You do not book a creator or a studio before release day.
Shops, including home brands, that need a Facebook or feed announcement and do not have a shoot on the calendar.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Start from a clear photo of the final item. A description alone will not match the real product. Name the reveal, then check the item before you post.
One clear photo of the finished item, with the whole product in frame. Wait until that photo exists before you make an ad.

faq.q: How is a teaser different from release day?
faq.a: A teaser can say the item is coming and carry a planned date as text you can edit. Release-day creative should show the live date, the current offer, and the product link.

faq.q: Which size and length can I pick?
faq.a: This template is set up for 9:16 and 1:1. Use 6 seconds for a quick reveal, or a longer length for a demo. The product also offers 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and the credit cost is shown before the job runs.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. A failed job returns those credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Can I run the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark. Add the confirmed date, price, and offer after download, and do not state a delivery promise you have not confirmed. A person on screen is an AI performer, not a customer.

steps.sourceTitle: Product photo of a sage-green canvas crossbody bag
steps.sourceHint: Show the uploaded sage-green canvas crossbody bag clearly before choosing the launch scene.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded product photo as the exact featured item. Show one adult creator lifting the uploaded sage-green canvas crossbody bag from a tabletop and holding it toward camera once. Bright home entryway, gentle handheld push-in, clear product focus, natural room sound, no spoken words, no text, labels, logos, numbers, or watermark.

picker.title: Choose a New Product Promo Video
picker.lead: These cards cover many categories. There is no launch-only filter. Open a reveal or unboxing card, then add a photo of the final item.

cards.label: ASMR Unboxing: Makeup Tools
cards.prompt: A seller can open with a close unboxing that lifts your makeup tools from tissue paper and puts the brush set in clear view.

cards.label: Cinematic Watch Detail
cards.prompt: A cinematic close-up can hold your watch in warm light while the camera glides across its face and strap.

cards.label: Bedroom Try-On: Knitwear
cards.prompt: Show your knitwear in a bedroom try-on as the creator turns in the mirror so the fit and sleeves stay visible.

cards.label: Street Style: Linen Set
cards.prompt: Take your linen set outdoors for a street-style walk that shows the fabric, movement and full silhouette.

cards.label: Lifestyle App Recommendation
cards.prompt: A creator can recommend your app from a real kitchen table while tapping through a clean, abstract interface on a phone.

cards.label: Streamer Reaction: App
cards.prompt: Use a streamer-style reaction to show the moment your app surprises a viewer, with the device screen kept clear and easy to follow.

cards.label: Routine Demo: Cream
cards.prompt: Film a quick morning routine where a creator opens your cream jar and applies it at a bright vanity.

cards.label: Bathroom Review: Moisturizer
cards.prompt: Let a creator give a direct bathroom review while holding your moisturizer beside his face and turning the jar toward the camera.

cards.label: GRWM Unboxing: Knitwear
cards.prompt: Build a get-ready moment around opening your knit sweater parcel and holding the full garment up before styling it.

cards.label: Mirror Selfie: Denim
cards.prompt: A mirror selfie can show your denim overshirt from collar to hem as the creator checks the fit before heading out.

cards.label: 360 Showcase: Linen Shirt
cards.prompt: Rotate your linen shirt through a clean 360 showcase so shoppers can inspect the collar, seams and full shape.

cards.label: Street Interview: Fitness Gear
cards.prompt: Ask a passerby to explain how your resistance band fits a workout, keeping the product in his hands as he answers.

cards.label: Tutor Demo: Study Tool
cards.prompt: A teacher can demonstrate your study tool at a classroom desk with a simple lesson that keeps the product in use.

cards.label: Talking Head: Skin Lesson
cards.prompt: Use a clear talking-head lesson to explain how your moisturizer fits a simple daily routine, with the jar held beside the speaker.

cards.label: POV Discovery: Court Gear
cards.prompt: Open from an athlete's point of view as your court gear is picked up and shown where the next play starts.

cards.label: Hook: Home App Walkthrough
cards.prompt: Start with a strong home-search hook, then let the creator walk through your app on a tablet with the property view kept abstract.

cards.label: Finance Hook: Phone Demo
cards.prompt: Use a direct phone demo to introduce your finance app and show the key navigation without exposing private figures.

cards.label: Realtor Walkthrough: Home
cards.prompt: A realtor can walk viewers through your home service outdoors while holding a tablet with a simple abstract property view.

cards.label: Sensory Hook: Citrus Sip
cards.prompt: Lead with the first sip of your citrus drink and capture the creator's sensory reaction in a tight cafe close-up.

cards.label: Street Interview: Snack Bite
cards.prompt: Ask for a real first-bite reaction to your snack on a busy street, keeping the food and expression together in view.

cards.label: Running Shoe Creator Showcase
cards.prompt: A runner holds your slate-blue shoe toward the camera during a riverside product recommendation.

cards.label: Trail Shoe Lace-Up Demo
cards.prompt: A trail runner tightens your olive-gray shoe laces on a forest path before heading out.

cards.label: Berry Bowl First Bite Reel
cards.prompt: A creator takes the first bite of your fresh berry snack in a bright kitchen routine.

cards.label: Resistance Band Home Demo
cards.prompt: A home workout creator demonstrates your resistance band through one clear movement.

cards.label: Pendant Creator Try-On
cards.prompt: A creator touches your brushed-gold pendant at the collarbone in a relaxed bedroom showcase.

cards.label: Silver Signet Macro Reveal
cards.prompt: A close product shot shows hands rotating your brushed-silver signet ring on linen.

cards.label: Wooden Toy Parent Play
cards.prompt: A parent and child stack your wooden shape toy together during a warm playtime scene.

cards.label: Dog Harness Park Setup
cards.prompt: A dog owner clips your teal harness onto a golden retriever before a park walk.

cards.label: Pet Brush Living Room Demo
cards.prompt: A pet owner brushes a calm dog with your wooden pin brush in a cozy living room.

cards.label: Post-Workout Bottle Check-In
cards.prompt: A gym creator raises your teal sports bottle after finishing a workout.

cards.label: Kettlebell Powder Reveal Reel
cards.prompt: A cinematic burst of orange and green dust reveals your plain matte kettlebell on a reflective black pedestal.

cards.label: Kitchen Appliance Evening Demo Reel
cards.prompt: A creator demonstrates your plain countertop appliance during an evening kitchen routine, showing its shape and controls in warm light.

cards.label: Low Profile Keyboard Review
cards.prompt: A desk creator points out your charcoal mechanical keyboard while pressing its keys.

cards.label: Pump Moisturizer Routine Reel
cards.prompt: A male creator applies your coral pump moisturizer to one cheek at a bright bathroom vanity.

cards.label: Sage Overshirt Unboxing
cards.prompt: A creator lifts your sage overshirt from a blank kraft mailer for a first-look unboxing.

cards.label: Mint Face Mist Hook
cards.prompt: A creator opens with a playful reaction while holding your mint face mist beside her cheek.

cards.label: Stadium Hydration Fan Moment
cards.prompt: A fan raises your orange hydration bottle during a lively stadium game moment.
